vopros: Where can I find a list or reviews of fractional CFOs who specialize in construction in Tampa Bay?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Here are the best places to start:

### Directories and review platforms

- **Sam’s List – Fractional CFOs for Construction in Tampa**  
  [samslist.com/fractional-cfos/industry/construction/city/tampa](https://samslist.com/fractional-cfos/industry/construction/city/tampa)  
  This is the most targeted directory I found: it lists construction-focused fractional CFOs serving Tampa and includes profiles, ratings, and client feedback. Featured providers include **STAXX Fractional CFO & Accounting, Ever Ledger, Pillar Wealth, Bison CFO, Proview CFO**, and others.

- **Sam’s List – Fractional CFOs in Tampa generally**  
  [samslist.com/fractional-cfo/tampa](https://samslist.com/fractional-cfo/tampa)  
  Useful for expanding your search beyond firms explicitly categorized under construction.

- **Clutch – Fractional CFO firms**  
  [clutch.co/financial-services/fractional-cfo-services](https://clutch.co/financial-services/fractional-cfo-services)  
  Clutch provides verified client reviews, service descriptions, minimum project sizes, and hourly-rate information. Confirm that a listed firm has actual construction experience before contacting it.

### Construction-focused providers to investigate

- **Build CFO** – [buildcfo.co](https://buildcfo.co/)  
  Specifically serves construction, real estate, and professional-services companies. The firm lists Tampa as a service location.

- **Civil CFO** – [civilcfo.com](https://www.civilcfo.com/)  
  Focused on construction-related businesses and fractional CFO services. Ask whether they currently serve clients in the Tampa Bay area.

- **Ascent CFO Solutions – Construction & Real Estate**  
  [ascentcfo.com/sectors/construction-real-estate](https://ascentcfo.com/sectors/construction-real-estate/)  
  Highlights construction-specific services such as job costing, margin analysis, cash-flow forecasting, WIP reporting, cost-to-complete tracking, and lender reporting.

- **K-38 Consulting – Tampa CFO services**  
  [k38consulting.com/tampa-fl-cfo-services](https://k38consulting.com/tampa-fl-cfo-services/)  
  Offers outsourced CFO services in Tampa and includes construction-specific client testimonials. Verify the depth of its construction specialization and request references.

### Tampa-area general fractional CFO firms

These may be worth comparing if they have relevant construction clients:

- **Highpoint CFO** – [highpointcfo.com](https://www.highpointcfo.com/)  
  Tampa-based, offering virtual and in-person services across Tampa Bay.

- **The Gabb Group** – [thegabbgroup.com/fraction-cfo-services](http://www.thegabbgroup.com/fraction-cfo-services)  
  Serves Riverview, Tampa, and surrounding areas.

- **Nperspective CFO & Strategic Services** – [Clutch profile](https://clutch.co/profile/nperspective-cfo-strategic-services)  
  Offers fractional, interim, and project-based CFO work, with a Tampa location.

When comparing candidates, specifically ask about experience with **WIP schedules, percentage-of-completion accounting, job costing, retainage, change orders, progress billing, bonding capacity, surety reporting, and construction cash-flow forecasting**. Also request two references from contractors similar in size and trade to your company.
